title: Ad-hoc contrib velocity and gap matrix
content:
Purpose: quick spreadsheet-style tracker to (a) estimate contributor velocity for next 2 sprints, (b) highlight cross-team coverage gaps, and (c) list immediate asks / blockers for handoff. Use as an async input to the weekly interlock call.

Table (rows are per-contributor / per-team rollup) - columns: Owner | Team | Role | EstHoursNext2Sprints | AvailHours | TODOHours (committed) | GapHours (=Avail - TODO) | BlockingIssues | Priority | ActionOwner | ETA

Rows:
1) Priya Kapoor | eng-serving-runtime | SWE-2 | 40 | 60 | 50 | +10 | Perf regression in kv-cache optimization (PR pending) | HIGH | Priya | 2026-05-21
2) Liam Chen | engineering-observability | SWE-1 | 30 | 40 | 35 | +5 | Missing metric for per-route token breakdown | MED | Liam | 2026-05-19
3) Marisol Vega | product-hosted-api | PM | 20 | 30 | 25 | +5 | Need decision on rollout window for canary | HIGH | Marisol | 2026-05-18
4) Zoe Patel | solutions-engineering | SE | 25 | 30 | 30 | 0 | Onsite pilot prep (docs + infra checklist) | MED | Zoe | 2026-05-20
5) Omar Ruiz | platform-engineering | Infra | 35 | 50 | 45 | +5 | Burst capacity claim pending billing review | LOW | Omar | 2026-05-25
6) Hana Saito | security-and-compliance | Security | 15 | 20 | 10 | -10 | KMS integration question blocking private deploy test | CRITICAL | Hana | 2026-05-17
7) Diego Morales | solutions-engineering | SE | 10 | 25 | 20 | +5 | Need sample dataset redaction checklist | MED | Diego | 2026-05-22
8) Legal intake (pooled) | finance-and-legal | Legal | 5 | 15 | 0 | -15 | NDA review backlog (3 customers) | HIGH | Legal Ops | 2026-05-26

Quick insight rows (auto-calcs - done manually here):
- Total EstHoursNext2Sprints (sum): 180
- Total AvailHours: 270
- Total TODOHours (committed): 215
- Aggregate Gap (Avail - TODO): +55 (headroom) BUT note: Critical blockers concentrated in Security and Legal reduce effective headroom by ~25h to +30h.

Immediate asks / notes to owners (scratchpad):
- Hana: can you confirm whether KMS test keys can be provisioned in the staging VPC by EOD Mon? If not, escalate to infra (Omar).
- Legal Ops: prioritize NDA queue for pilot customers A/B/C — one NDA needs signature before demo next week.
- Priya/Liam: consolidate perf regression telemetry into one shared dashboard + link to PR (GH#1284). If regression is >10% p50, trigger temporary throttle on that route.
- Marisol: decision on canary window — suggest Wed-Fri low-traffic 2-week window. Call out downstream alert owners.

Risks & mitigations (quick bullets):
- Risk: Security KMS delay stalls private-deploy smoke tests -> Mitigation: fallback to ephemeral encryption keys for demo (requires signoff).
- Risk: Legal backlog blocks customer-facing pilots -> Mitigation: defer external pilots to internal-only demo and parallel fast-track legal review.
- Risk: Observability metric missing -> Mitigation: short spike (2d) assigned to Liam, pair with SRE to add metric ingestion path.

Open questions (to be resolved in interlock):
- Can we reassign 10-15h from Priya to Hana for short KMS work (Priya has +10 headroom)? Pros/cons?
- Who owns the temporary encryption fallback policy? (Security + Infra?)

Notes-to-self (informal):
- This is intentionally compact; will paste into the meeting doc before sync.
- Keep one-off tasks short (<8h) where possible to avoid long tail.
- Track updates as comments on this sheet; when a blocker clears, mark the row with DONE + date.

Change log / short history (manual):
- 2026-05-12: created (initial seed from sprint planning).
- 2026-05-13: added Legal row and notes after sync with Legal Ops.
- 2026-05-14: updated Hana ETA and added KMS fallback option.

Row color guide (visual hint - not in text): RED = CRITICAL blockers, AMBER = medium, GREEN = ok/covered.

References: Confluence mini-capacity-review (linked), Jira ENG-4321 (perf regression), GH#1284 (perf PR), Legal intake board.

Next steps (for sprint triage):
- Owners update TODOHours and BlockingIssues by 2026-05-15 09:00 PT.
- Product Ops to aggregate final headcount/effort and publish to interlock doc by 2026-05-16.

-- end of sheet (keep short, we will iterate)
